description: Component for enriching a DataFrame with geolocation data looked up from an IP address column.

asset_name.label: Asset Name
asset_name.description: Name of the asset to create

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset key providing a DataFrame with an IP address column

ip_column.label: Ip Column
ip_column.description: Column containing the IPv4 or IPv6 address string to look up

lookup_mode.label: Lookup Mode
lookup_mode.description: 'database' (default) -- reads a local MaxMind .mmdb file via database_path/asn_database_path, no per-row network call, YOU must supply and refresh the file (see module docstring). 'web_service' -- calls MaxMind's hosted GeoIP2 web service per row (account_id_env_var/license_key_env_var required); no local file to maintain, but one network call per row, and ASN enrichment is NOT available in this mode (MaxMind's web service has no ASN endpoint).

database_path.label: Database Path
database_path.description: Path to a local MaxMind City/Country .mmdb file (e.g. GeoLite2-City.mmdb). Required for city/country/lat-lng/postal/subdivision fields in 'database' mode. NOT bundled or downloaded by this component -- point this at a file you already hold a MaxMind license for, e.g. one maintained by GeoIpDatabaseUpdaterComponent in this same registry.

asn_database_path.label: Asn Database Path
asn_database_path.description: Path to a separate local MaxMind ASN .mmdb file (e.g. GeoLite2-ASN.mmdb). ASN is always a SEPARATE MaxMind database from City/Country. Only used in 'database' mode; set this to populate asn_column/asn_org_column.

account_id_env_var.label: Account Id Env Var
account_id_env_var.description: Environment variable holding your MaxMind account ID. Only used in 'web_service' mode.

license_key_env_var.label: License Key Env Var
license_key_env_var.description: Environment variable holding your MaxMind license key. Only used in 'web_service' mode.

web_service_host.label: Web Service Host
web_service_host.description: MaxMind web service host. Only used in 'web_service' mode.

batch_delay.label: Batch Delay
batch_delay.description: Seconds to sleep between rows in 'web_service' mode, to respect rate limits. Ignored in 'database' mode.

city_column.label: City Column
city_column.description: Output column for the city name, or null to omit.

country_column.label: Country Column
country_column.description: Output column for the country name, or null to omit.

country_iso_code_column.label: Country Iso Code Column
country_iso_code_column.description: Output column for the ISO country code, or null to omit.

latitude_column.label: Latitude Column
latitude_column.description: Output column for latitude, or null to omit.

longitude_column.label: Longitude Column
longitude_column.description: Output column for longitude, or null to omit.

continent_column.label: Continent Column
continent_column.description: Output column for the continent name, or null (default) to omit.

subdivision_column.label: Subdivision Column
subdivision_column.description: Output column for the most-specific subdivision (state/region) name, or null (default) to omit.

postal_code_column.label: Postal Code Column
postal_code_column.description: Output column for the postal code, or null (default) to omit.

accuracy_radius_column.label: Accuracy Radius Column
accuracy_radius_column.description: Output column for the location accuracy radius (km), or null (default) to omit.

asn_column.label: Asn Column
asn_column.description: Output column for the autonomous system number, or null (default) to omit. Requires asn_database_path (database mode only).

asn_org_column.label: Asn Org Column
asn_org_column.description: Output column for the autonomous system organization name, or null (default) to omit. Requires asn_database_path (database mode only).

match_status_column.label: Match Status Column
match_status_column.description: Optional output column recording per-row lookup status: 'matched', 'not_found' (valid IP, no DB entry -- private/reserved ranges land here), or 'invalid' (unparseable IP string). Null (default) to omit.

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Enable partitioning: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly' for time-based; 'static' for a fixed set of values; 'multi' for date × static. Leave empty for unpartitioned.

partition_start.label: Partition Start Date
partition_start.description: ISO date string for the first partition, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based and multi partition types.

partition_date_column.label: Partition Date Column
partition_date_column.description: Column used to filter rows to the current date partition key (e.g. 'event_date', 'created_at').

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning. Required for static and multi types.

partition_static_dim.label: Static Dimension Name
partition_static_dim.description: Name for the static partition dimension in multi-partitioning, e.g. 'customer' or 'region'. Defaults to 'segment'.

partition_static_column.label: Static Partition Column
partition_static_column.description: Column used to filter rows to the current static partition value (e.g. 'customer_id', 'region').

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.

freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)
freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.

freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule
freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).

column_lineage.label: Column Lineage
column_lineage.description: Column-level lineage: output column → list of upstream input columns it derives from.

include_preview_metadata.description: Include a preview of the output data in metadata (first 5 rows as a markdown table). Used by builder UIs to render asset shape without warehouse access.
include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata

preview_rows.description: Rows to include in the preview metadata when `include_preview_metadata` is True. For long DataFrames (>10x preview_rows), a random sample is used so the preview reflects the data distribution; otherwise head() is used.
preview_rows.label: Preview Rows

backfill_policy.label: Backfill Policy
backfill_policy.description: Backfill execution strategy for a partitioned asset. 'single_run' materializes an entire backfill range in one run. 'multi_run' launches one run per partition (optionally capped via backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run). Leave unset for Dagster's default.

backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.label: Backfill Max Partitions Per Run
backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.description: For backfill_policy='multi_run' only: maximum partitions materialized per run. Leave unset for Dagster's default (1 partition per run).

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

description.description: Asset description shown in the Dagster catalog.
description.label: Description

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence.

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.

partition_end_offset.label: Partition End Offset
partition_end_offset.description: Passed through to the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition. 0 (the Dagster default) means a time-based partition set only ever holds COMPLETED windows. Set to 1 to include the current, still-in-progress window.

partition_timezone.label: Partition Timezone
partition_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition (defaults to UTC when unset).

name: GeoIP Lookup
